checks.name: stations capability and XML
checks.sql: SELECT station_id, name, CAST(has_met AS INTEGER), CAST(has_currents AS INTEGER) FROM buoys.main.stations() ORDER BY station_id

checks.name: latest normalizes IDs preserves missing
checks.sql: SELECT station_id, CAST(wind_speed_mps AS INTEGER), CAST(wave_height_m*10 AS INTEGER) FROM buoys.main.latest_observations() ORDER BY station_id

checks.name: observation UTC and units
checks.sql: SELECT strftime(time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'), CAST(visibility_m AS INTEGER), CAST(round(water_level_m*10000) AS INTEGER), CAST(dominant_period_s AS INTEGER) FROM buoys.main.observations('44013') ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

checks.name: inclusive time filters
checks.sql: SELECT count(*),count(wave_height_m),CAST(sum(wave_height_m) AS INTEGER) FROM buoys.main.observations('44013', start_time := '2026-01-01T00:10:00Z', end_time := '2026-01-01T00:20:00Z')

checks.name: large Arrow batch
checks.sql: SELECT count(*),count(DISTINCT time), CAST(sum(wave_height_m)*10 AS BIGINT) FROM buoys.main.observations('large')

checks.name: drifting layout
checks.sql: SELECT CAST(latitude*100 AS INTEGER), CAST(longitude*100 AS INTEGER), strftime(time,'%H:%M'), CAST(wave_height_m*10 AS INTEGER) FROM buoys.main.observations('drift')

checks.name: join metadata and observation
checks.sql: SELECT s.name, CAST(o.wind_speed_mps AS INTEGER) FROM buoys.main.stations() s JOIN buoys.main.latest_observations() o USING(station_id) ORDER BY s.name

checks.name: timestamp and provenance
checks.sql: SELECT CAST(bool_and(fetched_at IS NOT NULL AND source_url LIKE '%44013.txt') AS INTEGER), typeof(min(time)) FROM buoys.main.observations('44013')
columns: CAST(bool_and(((fetched_at IS NOT NULL) AND (source_url ~~ '%44013.txt'))) AS INTEGER)

checks.name: offline reference table
checks.sql: SELECT column_name, source_unit, output_unit, scale FROM buoys.main.measurements WHERE column_name = 'visibility_m'
